description: Training corpus for learned triage: real projects checked out just before a public security fix, in seven languages. `autoaudit bench label --corpus <this>` scans each project before and after its fix and labels alerts (see bench.label). Cases were found in GitHub Security Advisories / OSV and every fix commit was fetched and checked against its advisory. Licenses are each project's own; the corpus file stores only references, and the source code is fetched at build time. Do not redistribute checked-out code with a trained model.

cases.name: halo
cases.summary: Backup download resolves a user-influenced filename under the backups root without checkDirectoryTraversal (MigrationServiceImpl.download).

cases.name: kkFileView
cases.summary: The file name taken from a remote preview URL may contain ../ and is used to build the local download path (WebUtils / OnlinePreviewController.onlinePreview).

cases.name: jeecg-boot
cases.summary: SQL injection through /sys/dict/queryTableData: the keyword blacklist in SqlInjectionUtil missed geohash/gtid_* and multi-line comments. The query is built by MyBatis ${} in SysDictMapper.xml; the Java-side sink is the mapper call.

cases.name: spring-cloud-function
cases.summary: The spring.cloud.function.routing-expression message header is parsed and evaluated as SpEL in a StandardEvaluationContext (RoutingFunction.functionFromExpression).

cases.name: javamelody
cases.summary: XXE: the SOAP request body is parsed by an XMLInputFactory with DTDs and external entities enabled (PayloadNameRequestWrapper.parseSoapMethodName).

cases.name: hsweb-framework
cases.summary: hsweb-system-file/.../FileUploadProperties.java createStaticSavePath used the uploaded filename as-is in absPath + "/" + fileName where the upload is written (../ escapes); fix reduces it to a normalized base name.

cases.name: openremote
cases.summary: manager/.../datapoint/AssetDatapointService.java buildCopyToStdoutQuery concatenated attacker-controlled asset/attribute names into a COPY (SELECT ... crosstab(...)) statement run via CopyManager.copyOut; fix uses generated keys.

cases.name: sakai
cases.summary: conversations/impl/.../ConversationsServiceImpl.java saveTopic/savePost/saveComment stored unsanitized message HTML from the REST API, later rendered with unsafeHTML (stored XSS); fix runs FormattedText.processFormattedText.

cases.name: spring-boot-admin
cases.summary: spring-boot-admin-server/.../notify/*Notifier.java evaluated user-configurable SpEL message templates with StandardEvaluationContext (RCE); fix uses SimpleEvaluationContext. Release commit 2.6.10 (no commit in advisory).

cases.name: syncope
cases.summary: client/idrepo/console/.../ParametersModalPanel.java isXML() parsed admin-supplied parameter values with a default SAXParserFactory XMLReader (XXE); fix enables secure processing and disallow-doctype-decl.

cases.name: copyparty
cases.summary: copyparty/httpcli.py /.cpr static handler joined self.vpath[5:] onto the web dir and served it with tx_file without containment; fix checks the resolved path.

cases.name: geonode
cases.summary: Uploaded SLD XML parsed with lxml etree.XML(sld) with entity resolution (geonode/geoserver/views.py dataset_style_upload, helpers.py); fix passes XMLParser(resolve_entities=False).

cases.name: isso
cases.summary: isso/views/comments.py API.new escaped 'website' with quote=False and API.edit/moderate did not escape author/website before storing; fix escapes with quote=True.

cases.name: label-studio
cases.summary: label_studio/core/utils/io.py validate_ip (used by ssrf_safe_get before requests.get on import URLs) blocked too few ranges; fix adds an exhaustive banned-subnet list.

cases.name: modoboa
cases.summary: modoboa/lib/sysutils.py exec_cmd ran shell commands built by formatting user data (e.g. SpamassassinClient.learn in modoboa/amavis/lib.py); fix uses argument lists and makes shell opt-in.

cases.name: pgadmin4
cases.summary: web/pgadmin/utils/session.py FileBackedSessionManager built session file paths from the cookie sid with os.path.join and unpickled them (traversal to attacker file -> RCE); fix uses safe_join.

cases.name: psiTurk
cases.summary: psiturk/experiment.py advertisement()/give_consent(): request.args['mode'] concatenated into template source via insert_mode() and rendered by render_template_string (SSTI); fix passes mode as a variable.

cases.name: pyload
cases.summary: src/pyload/core/database/file_database.py update_link_info joined URLs into an f-string SELECT ... IN ('...') passed to self.c.execute; fix uses ? placeholders.

cases.name: ftp-srv
cases.summary: src/fs.js FileSystem._resolvePath() joined client paths (backslashes) without confining them to the root before fs read/write/delete; fix rebuilds path resolution.

cases.name: git-diff-apply
cases.summary: src/index.js gitDiffApply() interpolated remoteUrl into utils.run(`git clone ${remoteUrl} ${_tmpDir}`) (exec); fix uses spawn with an argument array.

cases.name: parse-server
cases.summary: src/Adapters/Storage/Postgres/PostgresStorageAdapter.js literalizeRegexPart() escaped only the first single quote of a user $regex value (replace without /g) before concatenating it into SQL; fix adds /g.

cases.name: serve-index
cases.summary: index.js html()/htmlPath(): directory path, file names and view parameter written into the listing HTML unescaped; fix wraps them in escapeHtml().

cases.name: systeminformation
cases.summary: lib/processes.js processLoad()/services() and docker/network functions: array parameters bypassed sanitizeShellString and reached child_process exec command strings; fix adds type checks.

cases.name: totaljs-framework
cases.summary: utils.js exports.set()/get() built JS source from the caller's path string and compiled it with new Function; fix rejects dangerous characters.

cases.name: directus
cases.summary: api/src/services/files.ts FilesService.importOne() checked the import URL's resolved IP before axios (DNS-rebinding TOCTOU); fix validates the connected IP in a shared axios instance.

cases.name: lobe-chat
cases.summary: src/app/api/proxy/route.ts POST: URL from the request body passed straight to fetch(url) and proxied back (SSRF); fix rejects private IPs.

cases.name: md-to-pdf
cases.summary: src/lib/md-to-pdf.ts convertMdToPdf() called grayMatter() with default options, so ---js front matter in untrusted markdown was evaluated (RCE); fix disables the js engine.

cases.name: vendure
cases.summary: packages/asset-server-plugin/src/plugin.ts: decodeURIComponent(req.path) passed into path.join(cacheDir, ...) in getFileNameFromRequest and the 404 handler (file read via ../); fix adds sanitizeFilePath().

cases.name: gogs
cases.summary: internal/database/release.go DeleteReleaseOfRepoByID ran git tag -d <TagName> without end-of-options, so a tag name starting with '-' became a git option (argument injection); fix uses gitRepo.DeleteTag. (Advisory: CWE-88 argument injection, filed under CWE-78 so the command-injection rules can match it.)

cases.name: grafana
cases.summary: pkg/api/plugins.go HTTPServer.getPluginAssets: filepath.Clean of the wildcard URL parameter joined onto plugin.PluginDir and served, so ../ escaped the plugin dir; fix cleans an absolute path and uses filepath.Rel.

cases.name: homer
cases.summary: src/coordinator/handlers/statistics_v4.go StatisticsHandler.V4StatisticsQuery passed the user-supplied rawquery field straight to h.flightService.Query (DuckDB SQL); fix validates it with sqlvalidator.ValidateRawSQL. Merge commit (diff vs first parent).

cases.name: perses
cases.summary: internal/api/toolbox/list.go: the 'project' query parameter was used unvalidated to build filesystem-database paths (?project=../projects reads arbitrary files); fix calls common.ValidateID. Merge commit (diff vs first parent).

cases.name: podinfo
cases.summary: pkg/api/http/echo.go Server.echoHandler reflected the request body with w.Write(body) and no Content-Type, so sniffing served it as HTML (reflected XSS); fix sets octet-stream, nosniff and CSP. Merge commit.

cases.name: seaweedfs
cases.summary: weed/server/volume_grpc_remote.go VolumeServer.FetchAndWriteNeedle fetched a caller-supplied S3 remote endpoint without auth (loopback/IMDS reachable, response read back); fix adds auth, validateRemoteEndpoint and a guarded dialer.

cases.name: semaphore
cases.summary: db_lib/CmdGitClient.go: user-set repository GitURL/branch passed to exec'd git commands (ls-remote, clone, pull) without --end-of-options (--upload-pack=<cmd> RCE); fix adds --end-of-options and ValidateGitURL.

cases.name: admidio
cases.summary: modules/sso/fetch_metadata.php: $_GET['url'] passed to file_get_contents($url) after only FILTER_VALIDATE_URL (SSRF); fix requires https and blocks private IPs.

cases.name: AzuraCast
cases.summary: backend/src/Service/Flow.php Flow::process(): request parameter flowIdentifier used raw to build chunk paths for file writes/moves (../ traversal); fix normalizes the path.

cases.name: dolibarr
cases.summary: htdocs/install/step1.php: POST db_* parameters with the weak 'alpha' GETPOST filter were written by write_conf_file() into conf.php (PHP code injection); fix tightens the filters.

cases.name: froxlor
cases.summary: Admin-controlled settings values reached shell sinks unescaped: FileDir::safe_exec("wget ... | sh -s email=" . adminmail) in lib/Froxlor/Cron/Http/LetsEncrypt/AcmeSh.php and passthru()/exec(strtr(...)) in lib/Froxlor/Cli/ConfigServices.php; fix adds escapeshellarg and repairs validation.

cases.name: mantisbt
cases.summary: core/history_api.php history_query_result(): $t_history_order (from $p_query_options['order'] / history_order config) was concatenated unsanitized into the ORDER BY clause of the DbQuery SQL; fix whitelists it to 'ASC'/'DESC'.

cases.name: torrentpier
cases.summary: library/includes/functions.php get_tracks() called @unserialize($_COOKIE[$c_name]) on a client-controlled cookie (also User::get_sessiondata); fix switches to json_decode.

cases.name: YOURLS
cases.summary: includes/functions-infos.php yourls_get_domain()/yourls_get_favicon_url(): attacker-controlled referrer host/path echoed into stats-page HTML (stored XSS); fix validates host and wraps in yourls_esc_url.

cases.name: AutoUpdater-NET
cases.summary: AutoUpdater.NET/AutoUpdater.cs parsed the remotely fetched appcast with new XmlDocument().Load(stream) and the default resolver (XXE); fix sets XmlResolver = null.

cases.name: C1-CMS-Foundation
cases.summary: Composite/Core/Serialization/CompositeJsonSerializer.cs deserializes untrusted JSON with TypeNameHandling.Auto; the allow-list in CompositeSerializationBinder.cs ignored generic type arguments; fix checks them recursively. Merge commit.

cases.name: Dnn-Platform
cases.summary: DNN Platform/Library/Services/GeneratedImage/DnnImageHandler.cs: the 'Url' query parameter passed a weak StartsWith check in UriBelongsToSite and was then fetched server-side (SSRF); fix adds a strict UriValidator.

cases.name: marten
cases.summary: src/Marten/Linq/SqlGeneration/Filters/FullTextWhereFragment.cs interpolated the caller's regConfig into SQL (to_tsvector('{_regConfig}'::regconfig, ...)); fix validates it as an identifier.

cases.name: Umbraco-CMS
cases.summary: src/Umbraco.Core/Services/TemporaryFileService.cs CreateAsync/Validate accepted an attacker-controlled FileName with ../ segments that is written to disk; fix adds IsValidFileName.

cases.name: YoutubeDLSharp
cases.summary: YoutubeDLSharp/YoutubeDLProcess.cs RunAsync built cmd.exe /C ... + ConvertToArgs(urls, options) for Process.Start on Windows, so unsanitized URLs/options reached a shell; fix removes the cmd.exe path.
